svg.text: The brig: sheer and body plan from the table of offsets (Admiralty draught ZAZ4607, 1802)
Metres; heights above her base, places forward of the mainmast. Grey: stations read off the body plan.
Half-breadth plan: top breadth (black), load waterline (blue), waterlines at 1.5, 2.3 and 3.1 m
Body plan: after body left, fore body right
